chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Zeisu in Sawm-le-nihte a sap khit ciangin, dawite zawh nading leh cinate a damsak theih nadingun thu a pia hi.
Tuate in Pasian’ Gam thu hilh ding ahi zongin, cinate damsak ding ahi zongin a sawl hi.
“Note in lampi ah zat ding bangmah na keng kei un. Ciangkhut ahi zongin, thung-ip ahi zongin, khomun ahi zongin, dangka ahi zongin, na keng kei un. Puanak nih na nei kei un.
Inn khatpeuh ah na lut uh ciangin, tua inn ah na paikhiat matengun na om un.
Mi khatpeuh in note hong nolh leh, amau khua pan na paikhiat uh ciangin, amau lang khatah teci a pang dingin, na khepeek nuai-a leivuite na singkhia un,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Amaute paikhia uh a, Lungdamna Thu hilhin, cinate damsakin, khuapi leh khuaneute ah a pai kawikawi uh hi.
Tua lai takin Menzipa Herod in Zeisu hihna thu khempeuh a zak ciangin a lungmang hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi kimkhat in, “Johan in a sihna pan a thokik zo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Mi kimkhat in, “Elijah hong kilang kik zo hi,” a ci uh hi. Mi kimkhat in, “Tanglai kamsangte khatpeuh mah a thokik zo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Herod in, “Johan’ ngawng ka tan zo hi. Hih bang thu ka zakna hih pa in kua ahi hiam?” ci-in Zeisu mu dingin a zong hi.
Sawltakte in Zeisu kiangah a paikik uh ciangin, ahihna thu khempeuh a zasak uh hi. Zeisu in amaute paipih a, gam daihna Bethsaida kici khua khatah a tung uh hi.
Mihonpite in a theih uh ciangin a delh uh hi. Zeisu in amaute hawlkhia loin Pasian’ Gam thu hilh a, dam nading a deihte a damsak hi.

Ni a tum dektak ciangin, sawm-le-nihte in va nai uh a, “Mihonpite in a kimkot khuaneu leh lo lai-ah pai-in, giah na’ng leh an nek ding zong dingin paisak ta in. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih laitak in gamlak ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.

Zeisu in, “Amau nek ding an note’n na pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in “Kote in pai-in hih mi khempeuh ading an ka lei kei uh leh, khomun pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih longal bangmah ka nei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Bang hangin hih bangin a gen uh hiam i cih leh, pasal bek zong tulnga bang a pha uh hi. Zeisu in, “Mite pawl khat sawmnga, a pawlpawlin tusak un,” ci-in a nungzuite thu a pia hi.
A nungzuite in a thupiak mah bangin a hih uh a, a om mite khempeuh a tusak uh hi.
Zeisu in khomun pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih la a, vantung lam ento-in thupha a piak khit ciangin balnen a, mite mai-ah lui dingin a nungzuite a pia hi.
Amaute’n ne uh a, a vekpi un a kham khit uh ciangin, a val a neng a themte a tawm uh a, seeng sawm leh seeng nih dim a ngah uh hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in gam daihna-ah thu a nget lai takin, amah tawh a nungzuite a omkhawm uh hi. Zeisu in, “Mihonpite in kei kua hi hong ci uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin
amaute in, “‘Baptaizpa Johan,’ a ci uh hi. Kimkhatte in, ‘Elijah,’ a ci uh hi. Midangte in, ‘Tanglai kamsangte khatpeuh a hingkik hi,’ a ci ciat uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in kei kua hi nong ci uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Piter in, “Nangmah in Pasian’ Khazih na hi hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in hih thu kuamah kiangah gen lo dingin a nungzuite a kham hi.
“Mihing Tapa in gimna tampi thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante leh laitheite in nial ding uh a, amah in thahna zong thuak ding a, ni thum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mi khempeuh kiangah Zeisu in, “Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuih nop leh, a pumpi nial a, ama singlamteh ni simin pua-in hong zui ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a nuntakna a gum nuamte in a nuntakna a mangthangsak ding hi. Keima hangah a nuntakna a mangsakte in a nuntakna a gum ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin, ama nuntakna mangthang leh, bang phattuamna ngah ding ahi hiam?
Keimah hang ahi zongin, ka thu hang ahi zongin a maizum peuhmah, Mihing Tapa in ama phatna, Pa phatna leh a siangtho vantungmite’ phatna tawh hong pai ciangin, tua mi a maizumsak ding hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Pasian’ Gam hih san takah a ding mi kimkhat in a muh uh matengin a si kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Hih thu a gen khit ni giat bang a phak ciangin, Zeisu in Piter, Johan leh Jakob te samin, thungen dingin mual tungah a kahto uh hi.
Thu a nget lai takin a meel kilamdang a, a puan zong paak a, a leng mahmah hi.
Moses leh Elijah ahi nihte in meel lamdangin kilang uh a,
Zeisu tawh kihoin Jerusalem khuapi-ah sihna a thuak nading thu a gen uh hi.
Piter leh amah tawh a omkhawmte a lusu uh hi. Ahih hangin a khan’lawh khit uh ciangin, Zeisu’ minthan’na leh amah tawh a ding khawmte a mu uh hi.

Tuate in Zeisu tawh a kikhen lai takun Piter in, “Topa aw, hih lai takah kote kong om uh ahoih hi. Nang ading buk khat, Moses ading buk khat, Elijah ading buk khat, buk thum kote hong lamsak in,” ci-in gen ding adang thei loin a gen hi.
Hih thu a gen lai takin meii khat in amaute tuam a, amaute in meii sungah a tum lai takun a lau uh hi.
“Hih pa in ka teelsa ka Tapa ahi hi. Ama thu na ngai un,” ci-in meii lak pan aw khat a ging hi.
Aw a gin’ khit ciangin Zeisu bek om a kimu hi. Amaute pau loin, tua hun lai taka a muh uh nate kuamah kiangah a gen kei uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin amaute mual tung pan a kumsuk khit uh ciangin, mihonpite in Topa a dawn uh hi.
Mihonpi lak pan mi khat in, “Sia aw, ka tapa hong en in, ci-in kong thuum hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah bek ta ka nei hi.
Dawi in amah manin amah thakhatin kiko a, a kam sung pan cilphuan bua dongin kongkawsak a, nakpi-in bawlsia-in a paikhia hak mahmah hi.
Dawi hawlkhia dingin na nungzuite kiangah ka nget hangin ahih thei kei uh hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, “Thu upna nei lo a lungkhauh pawlte aw, kei in note tawh bang tanvei omkhawm ding ka hi hiam? Note bang tanvei hong thuak zo ding ka hi hiam? Na tapa ka kiangah hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
A pai lai takin dawi in naupang lei ah puksakin a kongkawsak hi. Zeisu in kihhuai dawi taai a, naupang a damsak khit ciangin a pa kiangah a pia hi.
Amau khempeuh in Pasian’ vangliatna lamdang a sa uh hi.

Ahih hangin mi khempeuh in Zeisu hihna khempeuh lamdang a sak uh ciangin, a nungzuite kiangah Zeisu in, “Na lungsim uh ah hih thute tum ta hen. Mihing Tapa in mite khut tungah kiheek ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in tua thu a thei kei uh a, a theih loh nadingun a kiseel hi. A cihnopna zong amaute in a dong ngam kei uh hi.
Tua lai takin a nungzuite in amaute lakah kua lianbel hiam ci-in khat leh khat a kiseel uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute lungsim sungah kiseelna a theih ciangin, naupang khat samin ama kiangah a koih khit ciangin,
“Keima min tawh hih naupangno a ngai peuhmah in, kei zong hong ngai hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note lakah a neu penpa in milian ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Johan in, “Sia aw, nangma min tawh dawite a hawlkhia mi khat ka mu uh hi. Amah in eite hong zui lo ahih ciangin ka kham uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua pa na kham kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note lang khatah a pang lo mi in note tawh kipawlin a om hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Vantungah kilaktoh ding hun a tun’ dek tak ciangin, Zeisu in Jerusalem khua lam mainawhin a pai hi.
A mai-ah kamtaite a paisak hi. Tuate pai uh a, Zeisu ading mun bawl khol dingin Samaria khua khatah a lut uh hi.
Zeisu in Jerusalem khua lam pai dingin a mainawt ahih ciangin tua khua mite in a nolh uh hi.
Tua thu a nungzuite Jakob leh Johan in a muh uh ciangin, “Topa aw, kote in vantung panin mei kiasakin tua mite a kat nading na awi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu kihei a, amaute a taai khit ciangin khua dangah a pai uh hi.
Lampi ah a pai lai takun mi khat in, “Na paina khempeuh ah kong zui ding hi,” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Ngiate in kua a nei uh hi. Vasate in zong bu a nei uh hi. Ahih hangin, Mihing Tapa ahih leh, a lutang ngak nading mun a nei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Midang khat kiangah, “Kei hong zui in,” a cih ciangin amah in, “Topa aw, ka pa ka vui masak nading thu hong pia in,” ci-in a ngen hi.
Zeisu in, “Misite in amau misite na vui ta hen. Nang na hih leh, pai in la, Pasian’ Gam’ thu na hilh in,” a ci hi.
Midang khat in, “Topa aw, nangmah kong zui ding hi. Ahih hangin ka innah a om mite mangpha ka vaikhak masak nading thu hong pia in,” a cih ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Lawi lokhawhna leeng letsan len kawm a, nunglam a en mi in Pasian’ Gam tawh kituak lo hi,” a ci hi.
